name: sage-zendesk-qa
description: Grounded Zendesk product Q&A, capability and release research, Community workarounds, and ticket investigation with focused source routing.

interface.shortDescription: Zendesk product, release, and troubleshooting answers
interface.longDescription: Research Zendesk product questions, capability recommendations, launches and EAPs with focused official-source checks. Use Community, support cases, or Slack for specific evidence gaps, choose a source set, or interpret supplied evidence without searching. Google Drive and Zendeskdev are outside this Q&A research profile.
defaultPrompt: Research this Zendesk question using the relevant sources.
Which Zendesk capability fits this objective, considering recent releases?
Investigate this Z2 ticket and suggest a verified next step.
Use Zendesk Community only to research this question.
